style: A knowing museum guide beside an old drafting table.
lines: Compass. Drag between two made points, or choose them with arrows and Enter.
Straightedge. Drag between two made points. Extend switches between a segment and an infinite line.
Free point. Tap empty paper, or move the crosshair with arrows and press Enter.
Erase. Tap a point or stroke. Its dependent construction will also be removed.
Measure. Choose two points for length, three for an angle, or two strokes for their line angle.
Blank paper. Choose Point to place free points, or press O, arrows and Enter.
Choose any Book page. Show next step adds one faint reference stroke. Back to paper returns to your drawing.
Manual. Scroll to read about the instruments, keys, measurements and sources. Close returns to the paper.
Paper cabinet. Choose a starting sheet, save or load a device slot, or print your drawing.
Construction record. Scroll to read your moves. Close returns to the paper.
Choose a second made point. Escape cancels the first choice.
Compass opening retained. Choose a made point for the next circle centre.
This sheet has 600 objects. Use Paper to save it and begin another sheet, or Undo to remove a move.
